rules.description: Zamknięcie miesiąca w księdze pl-stat rozlicza VAT: podstawy i podatek należny po stawkach z faktur sprzedaży tego okresu, podatek naliczony z faktur zakupu, nadwyżka z poprzedniego miesiąca; do zapłaty, gdy należny przewyższa naliczony, inaczej nadwyżka do przeniesienia (ustawa o VAT art. 86, 87, 99; pozycje JPK_V7M P_10–P_62); do zapłaty i do przeniesienia w pełnych złotych (Ordynacja podatkowa art. 63 §1: należny i naliczony zaokrąglone, potem różnica), a należny jak w deklaracji — podatek każdej stawki zaokrąglony do pełnych złotych, potem suma (P_38 to suma zaokrąglonych pozycji), więc kwota do zapłaty i nadwyżka zgadzają się z JPK_V7M co do złotego; firma zwolniona z VAT nie rozlicza VAT i nie składa deklaracji (ustawa o VAT art. 99 ust. 7); kwoty w złotych (faktura w walucie obcej — jej netto i VAT w złotych)

fields.sales_net_23: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.sales_vat_23: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat))
fields.sales_net_8: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.sales_vat_8: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat))
fields.sales_net_5: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.sales_vat_5: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat))
fields.sales_net_0: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "0": coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.sales_net_exempt: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "zw": coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.output_vat: =sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat))
fields.purchase_net: =sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.net_pln, i.net))
fields.purchase_vat: =sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat))
fields.input_vat: =(sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) + sum(s in objects(vat_settlement, period, month(add_months($.period, -1))): s.vat_carry))
fields.vat_due: =if((round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up)) - round((sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) + sum(s in objects(vat_settlement, period, month(add_months($.period, -1))): s.vat_carry)), 0, half_up) > 0, (round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up)) - round((sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) + sum(s in objects(vat_settlement, period, month(add_months($.period, -1))): s.vat_carry)), 0, half_up), sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) - sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)))
fields.vat_carry: =if(round((sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) + sum(s in objects(vat_settlement, period, month(add_months($.period, -1))): s.vat_carry)), 0, half_up) - (round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up)) > 0, round((sum(i in objects(purchase_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) + sum(s in objects(vat_settlement, period, month(add_months($.period, -1))): s.vat_carry)), 0, half_up) - (round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "23": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "8": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up) + round(sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)) where i.vat_rate.code = "5": coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)), 0, half_up)), sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)) - sum(i in objects(sales_invoice, vat_period, month($.period)): coalesce(i.vat_pln, i.vat)))
